body:
## Summary

- Adds a new **Live Streams** section to the homepage, visually consistent with the existing Episodes carousel
- Creates `content/live-streams/` as a data-driven directory — new live streams are added by dropping a new `.md` file
- First entry `ls01.md`: **"How a Class Wrote a Paper on Human-Centered LLMs"** with guests Caleb Ziems, Dora Zhao, and Diyi Yang, linking to https://www.youtube.com/live/2d49pMXiJOA
- Cover image downloaded from the issue attachment to `quartz/static/covers/LS01-cover.png`
- Reuses the existing `EpisodeCarousel` component with a `live-streams/` path filter, placed after the Episodes carousel on the index page

## Test plan

- [ ] Homepage shows a "Live Streams" carousel below the "Episodes" carousel
- [ ] LS01 card displays the cover image, correct title, and links to the YouTube live stream
- [ ] Surge preview deploys successfully

Closes #48

**Sepo pushed fixes for this PR.** Branch: `agent/implement-issue-48/claude-26675540920`. Requested by @lolipopshock.

<!-- sepo-agent-fix-pr-status -->

- **Fixed hallucinated content** in `ls01.md`: replaced fabricated paragraphs with an accurate one-paragraph TLDR describing the guests' paper *"Reflections and New Directions for Human-Centered Large Language Models"* from Diyi Yang's cs329x class at Stanford.
- **Adapted episode page design for live-stream pages**: extended `isEpisodePage` logic in both `quartz.layout.ts` and `Content.tsx` to include `live-streams/` slugs — live-stream pages now use the same inline header (ID badge · title · date), YouTube embed at top, and suppressed standard page header as episode pages.
- **Fixed YouTube `/live/` URL parsing** in `Content.tsx`: `getYouTubeEmbedUrl` now handles `youtube.com/live/<id>` URLs (LS01's `youtubeUrl` uses this format), so the embed now renders correctly on the live-stream page.
